mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_record (examid, studentid, answers, score, objective_score, status, starttime, submittime, used_seconds, switch_count, auto_submit, ai_comment) VALUES (#{examid}, #{studentid}, #{answers}, #{score}, #{objectiveScore}, #{status}, #{starttime}, #{submittime}, #{usedSeconds}, #{switchCount}, #{autoSubmit}, #{aiComment})
mapper.select: SELECT er.*, e.title AS examtitle, e.total_score AS exam_total_score FROM exam_record er LEFT JOIN exam e ON er.examid = e.examid WHERE er.examid = #{examid} AND er.studentid = #{studentid}

SELECT er.*, e.title AS examtitle, e.total_score AS exam_total_score, s.studentname, s.studentno FROM exam_record er LEFT JOIN exam e ON er.examid = e.examid LEFT JOIN student s ON er.studentid = s.studentid WHERE er.id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS submitted, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(score), 1), 0) AS avgScore, IFNULL(MAX(score), 0) AS maxScore, IFNULL(MIN(score), 0) AS minScore, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN switch_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cheatSuspect FROM exam_record WHERE examid = #{examid} AND status >= 1
